hypothesis: On data_seed 1, the N=64-to-N=128 force decline comes from lower trained R2, not from a control effect, for fresh seeds as well as seeds 20-21 (where trained R2 went 0.74 to 0.66 with flat controls). Setup: seeds 22-23 at N=128, otherwise identical to the paired N=64 data_seed 1 seeds 22-23 arm. Trained force R2 and force control R2 are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and paired per seed. If the paired arm is unavailable, the comparison is reported as not computed.
expected_if_true: In both seeds: trained force R2 is >= 0.04 below the same seed's N=64 value; force control R2 changes by <= 0.03; final force margin in [0.06, 0.20]; headroom-normalised accel_step margin in [0.60, 0.78].
expected_if_false: In at least one seed, trained force R2 is within 0.02 of N=64, or the force control rises by >= 0.04 and accounts for most of the margin drop.
